title: PI objectives — tranche 9 (retrospective, 2026-11-28)
body:
# PI objectives — tranche 9

## Objectives

- **O1 (committed) — S20 closes with its review.** S20's closure review is published, its `meta.closure_outputs` names the category, and the project is re-closed through a gate decided by an approver distinct from its requester. Measured by `S20.json` green with `S20-project` and `S20-rework` passing.
- **O2 (committed) — S21's acceptance is evidenced.** S21 ships its charter, seven A–D artefacts, five registers, delivery contract, Phase-G review and both output bodies; the project stays active because its manifest pins it active. Measured by `S21.json` green.
- **O3 (committed) — S18's rework lands against the standard.** S18 ships the same authored set with its WBS deliverable carrying the refinement's four integers; it stays active because issue #12 is open. Measured by `S18.json` green.
- **O4 (uncommitted) — the tranche exit is green.** Three receipts fresh at one snapshot sha; `tranche-exit.json` written with `ready: true`.

## Business value

- `B1` auditable decisions — S20's keep/revert and comparison rows, and S21's ability to name the compiled text it audited by `(prompt_ref, prompt_sha256)`, are the tranche's clearest contribution.
- `B3` self-development — S18's improvement loop is the first instrument of "the conveyor develops and operates itself"; the rework makes its slice record complete.
- `B6` predictable delivery — every member's receipt and the tranche exit are the measurable half of the benefit, because a tranche that cannot show three green receipts cannot be forecast.

## Measurement

- The receipt is the instrument: `scripts/verify-project.py` reads the pinned snapshot, and its `verdict` is green or the tranche does not exit.
- The exit is the second instrument: `scripts/check-tranche-exit.py` refuses a stale or missing receipt, so a green from an older head proves nothing.
- The register is the third: the 13 open packages the three members carry (S18 4, S20 5, S21 4) are counted before and after, and a package clears only when its gap leaves a fresh audit or its finding carries `resolved_by`.
- `project_in_unauthorised_tranche:S20` is measured separately: it is P0 and clears only when the tranche has a recorded decision, never by a pack.

## Evidence

- `docs/evidence/rework/tranche-9/readiness-gate.md` — the pinned snapshot, the three content-checker results and the expected authorisation refusal.
- `docs/evidence/rework/{S18,S20,S21}.json` — the receipts at the execution snapshot.
- `docs/evidence/rework/tranche-9/tranche-exit.json` — the exit record.
- `docs/evidence/rework-register.json` — the register the before/after package count reads.
